program_claims.name: S3 braid + fusion
program_claims.claim: S3 braid+fusion is the topological primitive
program_claims.verdict: KEEP. Load-bearing topological primitive. Cyclic fusion (S3 + fusion measurement) is the universality reason, not a new bus.
program_claims.disputer: Braiding alone is not universal for S3; fusion measurement must stay in the gate set (Freedman–Larsen–Wang / Levaillant).
program_claims.kill: If fusion is dropped and braid-only compilation fails, E-S3 is no longer a universal primitive.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Surface-code / qLDPC error layer
program_claims.claim: Surface-code / qLDPC is the error layer
program_claims.disputer: Threshold papers are still Abelian; they do not make non-Abelian decoding free.
program_claims.kill: If a larger code makes logical error worse on the relevant platform, drop as default.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: RL / AI plant control
program_claims.claim: RL/AI control attaches to an existing plant bus
program_claims.verdict: KEEP. First attach point. No quantum hardware required.
program_claims.disputer: Loop cannot close inside tearing / Alfvén times if I/O is a quantum job queue.
program_claims.kill: Fail M2 if the module cannot beat the lab baseline on one disruption-relevant metric.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Majorana zero-mode qubits
program_claims.claim: Majorana zero modes as load-bearing qubits
program_claims.verdict: WATCH. Do not make load-bearing. S3 is the braid primitive we have.
program_claims.disputer: Trivial Andreev / YSR mimics; Nature caveat on Majorana 1; missing public X+Z logical on Majorana 2.
program_claims.kill: No independent X and Z logical ops with topological-gap scaling → drop as load-bearing.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Floquet time crystal as clock
program_claims.claim: Floquet time crystal as system clock
program_claims.verdict: CUT as metronome. Classical clock + QEC cycle only. Time-crystal physics stays on the reading list.
program_claims.disputer: Prethermal lifetime vs required shot duration.
program_claims.kill: Lifetime < control horizon → cut as clock.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Fracton hardware memory
program_claims.verdict: CUT from the hardware stack. Fracton codes remain theory. Do not store a control bit on a 3D multi-body Hamiltonian.
program_claims.disputer: No 3D fracton processor exists; Haah/X-cube remain theory.
program_claims.kill: If D stays D1, it cannot ride Bus B as memory.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Holographic encoding
program_claims.claim: Holographic encoding as a reactor/processor part
program_claims.verdict: CUT from the engine. AdS/CFT stays on the reading list. Not a reactor or processor part.
program_claims.disputer: Duality ≠ a tokamak I/O map. T=0 as a reactor part.
program_claims.kill: Already cut. Reversal needs two independent C≥4 sources.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Five-way coupled engine
program_claims.claim: Five subsystems coupled as one device
program_claims.verdict: CUT as a first system. Coupling is a new C1 claim. Reintroduce only after modules pass on one bus.
program_claims.disputer: Coupling is a new claim and starts at C1. No subsystem may raise another’s C.
program_claims.kill: A module that cannot state inputs, outputs, latency, and fail-safe is not a module.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Lindblad coherence penalty
program_claims.claim: Lindblad coherence penalty P_coh is computable vs n,T
program_claims.verdict: HOLD. First output must be P_coh vs n,T.
program_claims.disputer: Collision frequencies at fusion-relevant n,T vs optical pumping rate.
program_claims.kill: If P_coh / P_fusion ≥ 0.1 at any useful density, L1 fails.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Floquet / multiphoton barrier evasion
program_claims.claim: Floquet/Volkov drive enhances DT tunneling at reachable I,ω
program_claims.verdict: HOLD. Must beat published FV/CN baselines. Required fields are extreme.
program_claims.disputer: PRC 109 10^15–10^16 V/m; PRC 110 10^27–10^29 W/cm^2; KH vs FV disagreement.
program_claims.kill: After hole-burning + instability, net <2× thermal rate at reachable I,ω → Layer 2 off the plant path.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Vlasov / hole-burning / SRS-SBS
program_claims.claim: Vlasov / hole-burning / SRS-SBS must sit in the rate
program_claims.verdict: KEEP the solvers. Do not skip them. C1 for DBE coupling.
program_claims.disputer: Resonant depletion without repopulation kills bulk rate.
program_claims.kill: A rate that assumes infinite Maxwellian refill is void.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Cavity suppression + direct conversion
program_claims.claim: Cavity suppression + direct conversion are net sources
program_claims.verdict: HOLD. Energy sink, not a source.
program_claims.disputer: High-Z Bremsstrahlung (p-11B, Z=5) classically exceeds fusion power at equilibrium.
program_claims.kill: Model as a loss-reduction term with an independent unstaged-plasma baseline, or drop.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claims.name: Stack Q_eng ≈ 1000
program_claims.claim: Net Q ≈ 1000 from L1–L4 as written
program_claims.verdict: CUT as output. KEEP as ledger stress test. Fail-unless-proven. Not a number the paper may quote as a result.
program_claims.disputer: NIF Q_sci ≈ 4.13 (Apr 2025); JET Q ≈ 0.67; no MCF Q_sci > 1; plant Q unshown.
program_claims.kill: Any stack whose energy ledger omits drive, pumping, and conversion → reject the number.
program_claims.assessment_scope: Program-use decision in the pinned research snapshot; not universal scientific status.

program_claim_rubric.rule: PASS if C≥3 and T≥2 and D≥2. HOLD if C=2 and T≥2. CUT if T=0 or C≤1 after a distinguisher or D=0. Coupling is a new claim and starts at C1. Heuristic 0–100 gauges are harvest metadata and never move C.

C.meaning: No closed math, or math that contradicts a conservation law
Standard theory, textbooks agree, no relevant experiment
Analog or digital-quantum demo on a processor, not the target platform
Experiment on the relevant class of machine
Repeated by independent labs or in engineering use

T.meaning: Falsifiable only after a multi-year facility exists
Falsifiable in simulation against a published baseline this quarter
Falsifiable on existing hardware or a tabletop this year

D.meaning: Cannot be built; conflicts with measured rates or energy accounting
Module that can bolt onto an existing machine
Hardware that labs or companies are already building

A.meaning: A few papers, <50 citations, no company
Active literature or one serious lab/company line

program_claim_rubric.warning: Legacy Observatory harvest metadata; never substitute these axes for canonical SDBES assessments.
